payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois
lines_of_business: Not stated in the criteria; disclaimer says 'Carefully check state regulations and/or the member contract'
sections_in_order: Rationale (Regulatory Status, long evidence review, Summary of Evidence cervical and lumbar)
criteria_location: Coverage section, pp.1-3 only (cervical artificial disc single level, two level, subsequent level, investigational list; lumbar disc follows). The remaining ~40 pages are evidence review.
procedures_covered: Two-level simultaneous and subsequent adjacent-level cervical disc arthroplasty
Lumbar artificial disc (same document, out of scope here)

logic.top_level: all (one numbered all-of list per procedure variant: single level, subsequent level); two-level simultaneous is a by-reference rule
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Bulleted list 'considered experimental, investigational and/or unproven for all other indications, including but not limited to' containing more than two levels, disc plus fusion, prior surgery at level, prior fusion elsewhere, translational instability, deformity, RA/autoimmune, facet arthritis, infection, metabolic bone disease, malignancy. Criterion 5/5 also says 'free from contraindications' without listing them (the list is the investigational list).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Subsequent adjacent-level arthroplasty has its own 7-item list: criteria restated, 'different cervical level than the initial', 'fully healed'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: 3. ... due to herniated disc or osteophyte formation; AND a) ... failed at least six weeks ... ; or b) The individual has severe or rapidly progressive symptoms ... ; AND 4.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The 'AND' after item 3 comes before the a)/b) sub-items, which are an OR. Inline lowercase 'or' vs capital 'OR'. Sub-items are a one-of-two inside an all-of.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The disc will be used for single-level reconstruction following cervical discectomy within the C3-C7 region
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Restated unchanged for the second-level criteria, where 'single-level' sits oddly with a 2-level procedure.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: considered experimental, investigational and/or unproven for all other indications, including but not limited to
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Open-ended; the 'free from contraindications' leaf points to a list that is not labelled as the contraindications.

requirement_kinds.quote: using a disc approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)*
single-level reconstruction following cervical discectomy within the C3-C7 region

failed at least six weeks of conservative nonoperative treatment, including an active pain management program or protocol, under the direction of a physician, with pharmacotherapy that addresses neuropathic pain and other pain sources and physical therapy
severe or rapidly progressive symptoms of nerve root or spinal cord compression requiring hospitalization or immediate surgical treatment

Symptomatic nerve root and/or spinal cord compression are documented by ALL the following: a) Neck and/or arm pain; b) Functional and/or neurological deficit; c) Radiographic imaging (e.g., CT, MRI, x-rays, etc.)
intractable cervical radiculopathy and/or myelopathy due to herniated disc or osteophyte formation
Prior surgery at the treated level; Previous fusion at another cervical level; Translational instability ...
Clinical documentation that the initial cervical artificial intervertebral disc implantation is fully healed

thresholds.quote: failed at least six weeks of conservative nonoperative treatment
More than two level use whether done simultaneously or at different times

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: One flat CPT line at the end: 22856, 22857, 22858, 22860, 22861, 22862, 22864, 22865, 0095T, 0098T, 0164T, 0165T; cervical and lumbar mixed, not mapped to criteria. Disclaimer says presence or absence of a code has no relevance.

external_dependencies.what: FDA labeling for devices (Regulatory Status table)
external_dependencies.quote: *NOTE: Please refer to the Regulatory Status section for specific product information.
the benefit plan, summary plan description or contract will govern

vague_terms.quote: Radiographic imaging (e.g., Computed Tomography [CT], Magnetic Resonance Imaging [MRI], x-rays, etc.)
vague_terms.problem: x-rays and 'etc.' - very low imaging bar; no recency window

vague_terms.quote: active pain management program or protocol
free from contraindications to cervical disc arthroplasty
vague_terms.problem: list is in the investigational section, not labelled contraindications

extraction_hazards: Only 3 of 51 pages hold criteria; Coverage text is easy to find but evidence review (Table 1 of FDA devices, ~70 references) dwarfs it
Cervical and lumbar disc criteria share one section; lumbar has ODI >= 40 and 6 months which must not leak into cervical
Section nav table at top, page footers 'Artificial Intervertebral Disc/SUR712.028 Page N' repeated
Criteria restated almost verbatim for subsequent level
interesting_structures: Cervical 'subsequent level' list restates all single-level criteria plus 2 more
Contraindications expressed only as the investigational list

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Short, numbered, all-of with one OR sub-pair and a NOT list. Only the contraindication reference and vague imaging/deficit leaves strain it.
